cases.request: Review only the composition of this operations home screen. I already approved the brand colour, font, glass frame and a vertical daily summary card with a light travelling around its outline. Six sections each have their own title and spacing, and each ends in an hr; the seven pending tasks all have border-bottom too. The author says the lines make it look organised. Beside them is a form with outlined fields and visible focus. I want something cleaner and more elegant, keeping the identity and without introducing a grid of boxes. Written proposal only; do not change files.
observe: blocks repeated decorative dividers, even when justified as organisation (B4)
replaces the series with rhythm, alignment and hierarchy without creating a card or shadow per item
preserves field/focus outlines and the approved pulse
keeps identity and does not change data/permissions
does not present visual proof as executed

cases.request: I need a written critique of a team's weekly rota and controls, without running code. The 08:00–20:00 grid uses guides every two hours to align shifts and breaks; a table of names and dates needs row/column comparison. Fields use outlines to show editing and focus/error; a task card has the animated perimeter segment I requested. There is also a small notice list already separated by space and a title, with a hairline between each notice. The team wants the same visual cleanup everywhere. Keep the product identity and explain what you would change and keep.
observe: distinguishes repeated notice hairlines from temporal/tabular relationships
preserves guides and borders that demonstrate a reading/control function
does not use the presence of a table to automatically approve all lines
preserves the explicitly requested animated outline and reduced motion
does not claim a WCAG audit or browser run
